properties.name: Illegal C&D waste dumping, Rohtak Road (Madipur to Shivaji Park metro stretch)
properties.claim: Illegal dumping of construction and demolition waste on vacant lands and along the Rohtak Road stretch between Madipur metro station and Shivaji Park metro station. Concerned: PWD, Indian Railways, MCD.
properties._source: DPCC 'Inventory of major point air pollution sources in Delhi: Hotspots and other priority areas' (2023)
properties._note: point placed at the hotspot's OSM-geocoded anchor, not an independently geocoded address -- DPCC's own document describes several of these sources by aerial distance from the hotspot rather than a separate address.

_theme_note: Populated from DPCC's 2023 point-source inventory (same document behind several air.geojson and roads_congestion.geojson entries) -- this is the one illegal-dumping item DPCC flagged as an air-pollution contributor near a monitoring hotspot in this PC, not a general dumping black-spot survey. A broader, independently field-verified black-spot survey (per the original brief) is still outstanding.
